steps: Check the shelves for drips.
Place tall pots at the back and test tiles near the peephole.
Close the lid and write the load in the kiln log.

items.title: Mixing glazes
steps: Weigh the dry batch to the gram.
Sieve twice through an 80-mesh sieve.
Check the specific gravity before shelving the bucket.

items.title: Cleaning the wheels
steps: Scrape slip from the splash pan into the reclaim bucket.
Sponge the wheel head and the tray.
Leave the splash pan off so it dries.

items.title: Recycling clay
steps: Slake the scraps in the reclaim bin for a day.
Wedge on the plaster slab until it holds a thumbprint.
Bag it and label the bag with the clay body.

items.title: Ordering supplies
steps: Count the clay bags and write the number on the supplies list.
Order before the 20th so the delivery arrives before the first class.

items.title: Firing schedule
steps: Bisque goes to cone 04 over nine hours.
Glaze goes to cone 6 over eleven hours.
Never open the lid above 100 degrees.

items.title: Closing the studio
steps: Check that the kiln is off or running its programme.
Switch off the wheels at the wall.
Lock the side door and set the alarm.

items.title: When something breaks
steps: Put a sign on it and tell the studio lead.
Write the fault in the repairs book with the date.
Do not mend electrical items yourself.

questions.title: How should an order be confirmed?

phases.title: Before the firing
phases.note: Do these in order; the load is the last one.

steps.title: Wash and check the shelves
steps.body: Scrape old glaze drips with the flat stone, then wipe with a damp sponge. Look for hairline cracks along the edges.
steps.done: every shelf rings clear when tapped.

steps.title: Wad the pots that touch
steps.body: Press a pea of wadding under each foot that sits on a glazed shelf.
details: Never wad the rim of a lid.

steps.title: Switch the vent fan on
steps.body: The fan runs from its own breaker in the kiln room. Check that it spins before the first element switches on.
steps.done: the fan is audible and the airflow card lifts at the vent.

steps.title: Load, then close the lid
steps.body: Tall pots at the back, test tiles on the top shelf where the peep hole shows them.
steps.done: the lid seals with no light at the seam.

steps.title: Start the slow schedule
steps.body: Press Start on the controller and note the time in the log. Check the first ramp after thirty minutes.

steps-owners.note: Invented: mixing a shared glaze bucket, from the glaze table to the kiln.
steps-owners.intro: Mixing a new glaze bucket takes three people. The seat changes hands once, at the signed-off batch sheet.
steps-owners.label: Mixing a glaze bucket

steps.name: Weigh the dry batch
steps.done: every material is on the batch sheet to the gram.
steps.fail: A material runs short: stop, write the shortfall on the sheet and tell the lead.

steps.name: Sieve and mix
steps.done: the slop passes an 80-mesh sieve twice with no grit.
steps.fail: Grit stays in the sieve: re-mix for ten minutes, then sieve again.

steps.name: Sign off the batch sheet
steps.done: the lead has initialled the sheet and shelved the bucket.
steps.fail: A reading is outside its range: the bucket goes back to G2, not on the shelf.

steps.name: Fire a test tile
steps.done: the tile is back from cone 6 and photographed.
steps.fail: The tile crawls or runs: label the bucket Hold and tell the lead.
